Before you book

Quick answers

Everything else, we'll cover on the call.

Is the demo call free?

Yes. There’s no cost and no obligation. It’s a conversation to see if the partner program is right for you.

Who will I talk to?

A member of our partner team who knows the platform and the funding products inside out.

Do I need to prepare anything?

Not much. It helps to think about the business owners you talk to regularly. After you book, we’ll send a short checklist.

What does the program cost?

We cover licensing options on the call, once we understand your network and goals. We only bring on partners we believe can succeed.
